name: Artisan
tagline: Ava, an AI BDR that finds leads, runs outreach, and books meetings.
description: Artisan's flagship 'AI employee' is Ava, an autonomous AI BDR that sources leads from a database of 250M+ verified B2B contacts, runs personalized multi-channel campaigns across email, social, and phone, handles replies and objections, and books meetings. The platform integrates with existing GTM stacks like HubSpot and Salesforce with no migration.
insight: Raised a $25M Series A in April 2025 led by Glade Brook Capital, with HubSpot Ventures and Y Combinator.
edge: Packages a single named 'AI BDR employee' (Ava) as a near-complete human-BDR replacement — the hardest autonomous-employee positioning of the cohort.

references.title: Artisan: $25 Million Series A Raised For Outbound Sales Platform
